name: The Moonlit Oath
summary:
Step into the heart of The Moonlit Oath, where destinies entwine. An online card strategy RPG, where secrets unravel and fate is yours to shape.

The Moonlit Oath is a breathtaking Chinese fantasy strategy RPG game that brings together exquisite anime artistry, fate and destiny storytelling, and immersive adventure. Step beneath the moonlight, where every heartbeat echoes with destiny.
In this free online game, you’ll explore an enchanting oriental ancient world filled with light-hearted moments, betrayal, and mystery. Experience cinematic story moments, collect nobles through gacha, fight through fierce turn-based battles in RPG card game, express your style with fashion and makeup, and fight to uncover the secrets written in the stars.

Will your oath lead to happy ending or reveal a truth that could shatter your world?

Your Oath, Your Destiny.
